verdict.rationale: The evidence confirms Cursor ships a Tab completion feature, but only indirectly. The API-keys help page says "Tab completion continues using Cursor's built-in models," and the Analytics API exposes tab-usage metrics and accepted AI-suggested edits. Nothing describes how inline completions behave as you type, and next-edit suggestions are never mentioned. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs on inline Tab completions, any evidence of next-edit/multi-line edit prediction, hands-on or independent corroboration of completion quality and latency.
